title: Gate list for a program prefix
statement: Let $n,m,w$ be natural numbers, let $\kappa$ be a type with a chosen element, let $F$ assign a finite Boolean list to each pair consisting of an element of $\kappa$ and a finite Boolean list, and let $\mathrm{prog}$ be a finite list of instructions, each carrying an element of $\kappa$. Define a gate list $G_i$ for every natural number $i$ by taking $G_0$ to consist of the constant-false and constant-true gates, and, for each $i$, forming $G_{i+1}$ by appending to $G_i$ the embedded gadgets for the kind carried by instruction $i$ (using the chosen element when that instruction is absent), with source vertices determined by that instruction and base offset $n+2$ plus the total widths of the preceding instructions.
hypotheses_covered: A type $\kappa$ with a chosen element
A finite list of instructions carrying elements of $\kappa$
The gate list is defined for every natural-number index by the stated zero and successor clauses
